title: CSS Box Model
description: Understand the CSS box model and box-sizing property.

options.text: With box-sizing: content-box, padding and border are included in the element's specified width
options.explanation: content-box is the default — width/height only apply to the content area. Padding and border are ADDED on top, making the element larger than the specified width.

options.text: With box-sizing: border-box, the specified width includes content, padding, and border
options.explanation: border-box makes width/height include content + padding + border. This makes layouts more predictable — a 200px wide element is always 200px regardless of padding/border.

options.text: Margin is included in box-sizing calculations
options.explanation: Margin is NEVER included in box-sizing calculations for either content-box or border-box. Margin is the space outside the border.

options.text: box-sizing: border-box is the browser default for all elements
options.explanation: The default is content-box. Most CSS resets include `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }` because border-box is more intuitive for layout.
